How It Works

## Four steps to better dealflow

Step 1

### Track VCs on Twitter

We monitor who top-tier VCs follow on Twitter. These follows often signal early interest in promising founders.

Step 2

### LinkedIn Enrichment

We match Twitter accounts to LinkedIn accounts using our proprietary identity resolution and enrich our records with work history and education.

Step 3

### AI-Powered Labeling

Our AI analyzes both Twitter and LinkedIn to label each person as founders, engineers, investors, etc.

Step 4

### Raw Data Delivery

Get CSV exports or pull data via our API. Filter for unfunded founders or any criteria you want.

## Find exactly who you want

Our AI analyzes Twitter bios and LinkedIn work history to label each person and write a bio. Find unfunded founders, researchers turning entrepreneur, or whatever your thesis requires.

`founder`

Explicitly identifies as a current startup founder or co-founder

`funded`

Founder who has raised over $500k in venture capital

`non-vc`

Founder of a bootstrapped company, agency, or small business

`engineering`

Software Engineer, Tech Lead, CTO, or similar technical role

`product`

Product Manager, Head of Product, or product-focused role

`design`

Product Designer, UX Designer, or design-focused role

`research`

Professor, researcher, or PhD student in academia

`investor`

VC partner, angel investor, or works at a venture firm

`student`

Currently enrolled in undergrad or graduate school

`web3`

Works in or frequently discusses blockchain/crypto topics

Example: Many early stage VCs will filter down to rows with the `founder` label and without the`funded` label to find stealth-mode founders before anyone else.
